EVA.Core.Pricing.PushPriceList.description: A service that allows to manage the entirety of a price list.

ActiveForOrganizationUnits.description: The organization units that use this pricelist. If left empty will leave the current configuration unchanged. If specified, will replace the current configuration.

Components.description: The list of components that make up the pricelist. If left empty this will leave the current configuration unchanged. If specified only the components present will be modified. Components must be explictly deleted.

CurrencyID.description: The currency for the pricelist. Must be present for the creation of a pricelist but can be left empty in subsequent calls.

ID.description: The unique identifier for this pricelist.

IsActive.description: Whether or not the pricelist is active.

LowProductCountOption.description:
The PushPriceList service is optimized for updating a pricelist in its entirety, so for many products at once when using a PriceEntry component. When using few products or even single products this service can perform unnecessary work. It's always recommended to
use this service in a large batch manner but if that's not possible you can specify your intent by using either LowProductCountOption = Auto or Optimize. Effectively this service will simply store the new price entries and return.
The updated prices won't become effective until the next calculation round, which happens every 15 minutes. The threshold for 'low product count' is set at 100 products.

Name.description: The name of the pricelist. Must be present for the creation of a pricelist but can be left empty in subsequent calls.

RecalculateEffectivePrices.description:
Whether or not to immediately recalculate the effective prices after processing the changes. Otherwise, the prices are automatically recalculated every 15 minutes. Until such a recalculation has been performed, the old price will remain active.
Defaults to false, only specify as true if you cannot wait for the normal recalculation cycle.

SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax.description:
If set to true then all prices specified on this price list will be interpreted as already VAT-included. If set to false then all prices will be interpreted as VAT-excluded. If not specified then the default value is true.

So if a price entry of 90 EUR is added to this pricelist with SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax = true (or not specified) then the price will be interpreted as 90 EUR already including VAT.
If SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax = false then the price will be interpreted as 90 EUR excluding VAT so that will be added on top for any orders created with this price.

SystemID.description:
A string that identifies the system that was used to call this service. In combination with the ID of the pricelist, this is what uniquely identifies the pricelist in EVA.
The SystemID must be the same for every call, if it's different from a previous call then a new pricelist will be created.

TimeZone.description: The timezone that will be used to interpret activation times for prices.

WaitForCompletion.description: If specified as true, the call to PushPriceList will not return until all uploaded prices have been stored and all prices have been recalculated. Normally this process runs in the background.

CopyPricesFromOtherPriceListData.description:
The data that accompanies a Component with Type = PricesFromOtherPriceList which is a component to copy prices from another pricelist.

Is useful for example for promotion prices, where you first 'import' the prices from the original pricelist, and then apply a negative markup to them to create a promotion discount.

Which prices you copy can be modified by specifying a ProductSearchTemplateID, only products that are contained in the results of the search will be copied,
unless ExcludeProductsInFilter is set to true, in which case the reverse is true; all products except the matching ones will have their prices copied.

Delete.description: If specified as true, the component will be deleted.

EndDate.description: Determines when this component will become inactive. After this date the component will not be included in the calculation of the pricelist.

ID.description: The unique identifier for this component. Required.

MarkupData.description:
The data that accompanies a Component with Type = Markup which is a component that alters the price value of the previusly applied components,
either up or down. The markup/markdown can either be an absolute value or a percentage depending on the Type.

Name.description: The name of the component. If left empty on creation of the component the ID will be used as the name.

OverrideCurrentCalculatedPrice.description:
Determines if the price resulting from this component simply replaces the value as calculated by preceding components or if it's a relative value.

It defaults to false.

This affects the different component types in the following ways:

PriceEntries:

If OverrideCurrentCalculatedPrice = true then the value of the price entry replaces any value by a previous component. If false (the default) then the price entry is added to the existing value.

So if a previous component calculated that the price should be 100 and there is a price entry for 90, then with OverrideCurrentCalculatedPrice = true the resulting price will become 90. With false, it would become 190.

Markup:

It's only applied to a markup component if it has Type = Amount, it does not have any effect for Type = Percentage.

If set to true, a Amount markup component will function like a price entry compnent and replace the current value with the amount of the markup component.

If false (the default) it will add the Amount of the markup component to the current calculated value.

PriceEntriesData.description:
The data that accompanies a Component with Type = PriceEntries, so a component that is simply a list of product/price pairs.
The simplest and most direct way to give a product a price.

This data consists of either a list of product/price pairs or a BlobID which is a reference to a previously created blob in EVA that contains data of the following format:

[
    {
      "ProductID": "<ProductID>",
      "Price": <Price>
    },
    ...
]

If you only supply a handful of prices, the inline data works well, but for large quantities of prices you may want to use the BlobID method.

This data is ignored for all other Component types.

PriceEntries data is processed asynchronously in the background and will not be immediately visible after the service call returns.

PricingGroupID.description: The PricingGroupID that this component is active for. Components with a PricingGroupID are only active for users that are members of that group. If left empty the component will be active for all users.

SequenceNumber.description: Components are applied in the order of their sequence number, from lowest to highest.

StartDate.description: Determines when this component will become active. Until then the component will not be included in the calculation of the pricelist.

Type.description: Determines the type of the component. Cannot be changed after creation.

ExcludeProductsInFilter.description: If true, all products except the matching ones will have their prices copied. If false, only the matching ones will have their prices copied.

PriceListID.description: The ID of the pricelist to copy prices from.

ProductSearchTemplateID.description: The ID of the ProductSearchTemplate to use to filter the products to copy. If left empty all products will be copied.

ExcludeProductsInFilter.description: If true, all products except the matching ones will have their prices copied. If false, only the matching ones will have their prices copied.

FactorValue.description:
The value of the markup/markdown. If Type is Amount, this is the amount to add to the price.
If Type is Percentage, this is the amount that the Price will be multiplied by.

A 10% markup should be specified as 1.10, a 25% discount should be specified as 0.75.

ProductSearchTemplateID.description: The ID of the ProductSearchTemplate to use to filter the products to copy. If left empty all products will be copied.

Type.description: The type of markup/markdown. Either absolute amount or a percentage. Determines how FactorValue will be interpreted.

Prices.description: The inline data that will be used to create the price entries. If left empty the blob will be used.

RemoveUnprovidedEntries.description: If set to true, all existing price entries for this component that are not included in this push will be removed. Use this when pushing the full state of a price list to clean up entries that should no longer exist. Defaults to false.

Cost.description: The price that is used to calculat what the cost price is of products that are sold to the party who sells it.

EcoTax.description: Economic taxes (recycling fees) can be used for display purposes, not used in any logic.

PotentialDiscountedPrice.description: Can be used to give an indication of effective product prices after applying discounts. This is purely for display purposes.

Promotion.description: A promotional price reduction of the normal Sales price.

Purchase.description: The price that is used for sales prices between organizations in a B2B scenario.

RecommendedRetail.description: RecommendedRetail prices can be used for display purposes, not used in any logic.

Sales.description: The price that is used as the price that a product is sold for in the normal B2C scenarios.

UnknownProducts.description: Returns unknown products that could not be processed. Only supported with low product counts.

EVA.Core.Pricing.PushPriceLists.description: Push multiple price lists in a single call. Each price list follows the same format as PushPriceList.

ActiveForOrganizationUnits.description: The organization units that use this pricelist. If left empty will leave the current configuration unchanged. If specified, will replace the current configuration.

Components.description: The list of components that make up the pricelist. If left empty this will leave the current configuration unchanged. If specified only the components present will be modified. Components must be explictly deleted.

CurrencyID.description: The currency for the pricelist. Must be present for the creation of a pricelist but can be left empty in subsequent calls.

ID.description: The unique identifier for this pricelist.

IsActive.description: Whether or not the pricelist is active.

Name.description: The name of the pricelist. Must be present for the creation of a pricelist but can be left empty in subsequent calls.

SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax.description:
If set to true then all prices specified on this price list will be interpreted as already VAT-included. If set to false then all prices will be interpreted as VAT-excluded. If not specified then the default value is true.

So if a price entry of 90 EUR is added to this pricelist with SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax = true (or not specified) then the price will be interpreted as 90 EUR already including VAT.
If SpecifiedPricesIncludeTax = false then the price will be interpreted as 90 EUR excluding VAT so that will be added on top for any orders created with this price.

SystemID.description:
A string that identifies the system that was used to call this service. In combination with the ID of the pricelist, this is what uniquely identifies the pricelist in EVA.
The SystemID must be the same for every call, if it's different from a previous call then a new pricelist will be created.

TimeZone.description: The timezone that will be used to interpret activation times for prices.

EVA.Core.Pricing.UpdateManualTaxExemptio.description: Update a manual tax exemption reason.

EVA.Core.Pricing.UpdateSimplePrices.description:
Update the prices in the pricelist specified.

This service takes a simplified approach of the pricing tools EVA offers, but that limits the options you have available. The price list to update may
only have a single active adjustment, and that has to be of type `MANUAL_INPUT`.

* The pricelist is identified by the `PriceListID` or the `BackendSystemID` and `BackendID`.
* Products can be identified by their (EVA) `ID`.
* Updates from this service are persisted in the background, which could take up to 15 minutes to process (unless you set `ForcePriceListRecalculation` to `true`)

ForcePriceListRecalculation.description: Set this to `true` when an immediate persistance of these prices is required. Not recommended; background recalculation is usually done within 15 minutes.

NewPrice.description: Leave empty to delete the price for this product

EVA.Core.Pricing.UpdateTaxRate.description:
Modifies a tax rate.

:point_right: See `CreateTaxRate` service for more info.

Category.description:
Defines in which category the provided Rate falls for the provided CountryID. For example, a rate of 25% in the country Denmark should have Category = High as 25% is the high VAT rate in Denmark.

If the TaxCode used for this TaxRate is one of the predefined ones (High, Low, Zero, Exempt, Intermediate) this parameter is ignored but Category must be provided when using a custom TaxCode.

The Category `Dynamic` should be used for countries such as the US where the actual tax rate is context dependent and calculated dynamically.

EVA.Core.Printing.Print.description: Pushes a blob (by `BlobID` or `BlobUrl`) to a device of specified `Type` on given `StationID`.

BlobID.description: Can be used for standard blobs - for secure blobs, use `BlobUrl` instead.

BlobUrl.description: Can be used for both standard- and secured blobs - must match environment assets URL.

EVA.Core.Printing.RenderThermalPrintResu.description: Renders the result of a previous thermal print job to HTML and/or PDF. Supply either a `BlobID` or `BlobUrl`.

BlobID.description: Can be used for standard blobs - for secure blobs, use `BlobUrl` instead.

BlobUrl.description: Can be used for both standard- and secured blobs - must match environment assets URL.

OutputFormat.description: The output format. It's possible to provide both HTML and PDF. When Html is specified the response will contain the thermal print result inside the `Html` field.

EVA.Core.Printing.ReprintThermalPrintRes.description: Reprints the results of a previous thermal print job to a specified station. Supply either a `BlobID` or `BlobUrl`.

BlobID.description: Can be used for standard blobs - for secure blobs, use `BlobUrl` instead.

BlobUrl.description: Can be used for both standard- and secured blobs - must match environment assets URL.

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.AddBundleProduct.description:
The normal `AddProductToOrder` cannot be used for adding a Product with type `BundleProduct` to an order. Instead, `AddBundleProductToOrder` must be
used. In addition to the `BundleProductID`, this service accepts an optional `LineSelection`, which represents the bundle's configuration in terms of
which products you've chosen.

The `LineSelection` data structure contains a `SelectedProductID`, which must refer to a ProductID that is a valid option for this bundle, according
to what `GetBundleProductDetails` returns.

If no `LineSelection` is provided then the default products of the bundle are added to the Order.

ForceNewLine.description: This will always create new lines, ignoring existing OrderLines that could be included in the bundle.

ParentOrderLineID.description: If specified the new bundle OrderLine becomes a child of the specified OrderLine.

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.ApplyBundleProdu.description:
This service is used to apply a selection of products to the provided `BundleProductOrderLineID`.
The `BundleProductOrderLineID` field refers to the ID of an `OrderLine` on the provided `Order` that has a `BundleProduct` Product on it.
The `LineSelection` field is a list that couples a `SelectedProductID` to a `ProductBundleLineID` and is identical to how it's used in `AddBundleProductToOrder`.

CancelUnselectedOptionalBundleLines.description: When true, optional bundle lines that are not included in the current selection are automatically cancelled from the order. When false, existing optional lines are kept.

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.CreateProductBun.description: This service creates a ProductBundle for the given BundleProductID.

IsPromptSuppressed.description: Should the FE suppress the modal that allows the user to select a matching bundle for the scanned product

Lines.description: Specify the lines of the product bundle. If left empty or null at creation, these can be filled in by calling `UpdateProductBundle`.

Type.description: Specifies the type of bundle: discount (0) or configurable (1). The type can not be changed after the bundle has been created.

DefaultProductID.description: Required when there are multiple options for a required line, or when any product of `Options` is of type `Configurable`. Otherwise it is optional. The DefaultProductID cannot be a `ConfigurableProduct` or a `BundleProduct`.

ProductID.description: ID of a product. Specifying a `BundleProduct` would create a bundle of bundles.

AssortmentRuleSummary.description: Summary of assortment rule evaluation for the bundle product in the current assortment.

IsPromptSuppressed.description: Should the FE suppress the modal that allows the user to select a matching bundle for the scanned product

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.GetBundleProduct.description:
Gets the details of a bundle by its ProductID. The input to this service is `BundleProductID` which refers to the ID
of a `Product` that has `Type` = `BundleProduct`.

The details of a bundle is a structure containing the lines of the bundle, the available options for each line
of the bundle and, if it's a bundle of bundles or a bundle of configurable products, this structure is recursive; each option
can have lines of its own again. So the output of this service contains a tree of all the available products for the bundle.

The `IncludedFields` parameter is optional and allows you to specify which fields you wish to get back from this service.

This service returns a list of bundle products that contain the `ProductID` in the request.
The service is meant to be used on a product detail page as a "this product is also available in these bundles" component.
The request allows you to specify what data you'd like to get back from the bundle product, through the `IncludedFields` field.

MaxBundleProductsToReturn.description: The maximum number of bundle products to return that contain the provided ProductID. Defaults to 200.

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.GetPotentialBund.description:
This service returns the bundles for which you currently have at least one product in the provided order.
This can then be used to suggest bundles to the end-user that they're missing out on.

The IncludedFields field controls which product content you get back for each bundle product. By default, only the product's display value is returned.

Specifying the ProductIDs field means that only suggestions for the given products are returned.
If the Order does not contain the provided ProductIDs, nothing will be returned.

MaxBundleProductsToReturn.description: The maximum number of bundle products to return per product. Defaults to 200.

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.GetProductBundle.description: This service is used to fetch a `ProductBundle` by its ID. The requested bundle will be returned with its lines and for each line, its options.

HasNonDefaultOptions.description: Indicates whether the bundle has any non-default options. If it doesn't, there is no need to configure it after adding it to an order.

IsPromptSuppressed.description: Should the FE suppress the modal that allows the user to select a matching bundle for the scanned product

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.ListProductBundl.description: This service returns a paged summary of `ProductBundles`, for each bundle it contains the `BundleProduct` and the pricing information for the bundle.

HasNonDefaultOptions.description: Indicates whether the bundle has any non-default options. If it doesn't, there is no need to configure it after adding it to an order.

IsPromptSuppressed.description: Should the FE suppress the modal that allows the user to select a matching bundle for the scanned product

EVA.Core.ProductBundles.UpdateProductBun.description:
This service is largely the same as CreateProductBundle.
The model passed into the request body is considered to be the entire bundle configuration.
Any lines that are currently present but not present in the update model are removed from the bundle.
The only parameter that is different is that the model requires an ID to be set for the root object and its lines, which you get back from the `GetProductBundle` and `ListProductBundles` services.

IsPromptSuppressed.description: Should the FE suppress the modal that allows the user to select a matching bundle for the scanned product

DefaultProductID.description: Required when there are multiple options for a required line, or when any product of `Options` is of type `Configurable`. Otherwise it is optional. The DefaultProductID cannot be a `ConfigurableProduct` or a `BundleProduct`.

ID.description: Can be left null for new lines to be added to the bundle.

EVA.Core.ProductRecommendations.DeletePr.description: Service for deleting an existing `ProductRecommendation` by ID

EVA.Core.ProductRecommendations.GetProdu.description: Service for retrieving an existing `ProductRecommendation` by ID

EVA.Core.ProductRecommendations.GetQuick.description: Service for retrieving a list of `QuickBuy` options

EVA.Core.ProductRecommendations.ListProd.description: Service for retrieving a list of `ProductRecommendation`

EVA.Core.ProductRecommendations.UpdatePr.description: Service for updating an existing `ProductRecommendation` by ID

exclusive_sellable_tier.description: Name of the first tier this product is sellable for, only present if the product is NEVER sellable for the current user.

exclusive_tier_remaining_points.description: If the ExclusiveSellableTier is present, this field contains the number of points remaining for the user to reach that tier. Other additonal requirements may apply.

has_rules.description: Indicates whether there are any assortment rules that apply to this product for the current user. This is only returned for employees

is_visible.description: Indicates whether the product is visible to the user. This is only returned for employees, as for customers this product isn't returned at all.

message.description: Message that can be shown to the user when either SellableTier or ExclusiveSellableTier is present, to communicate why the product is or isn't sellable.

sellable_date.description: Date when the product becomes sellable. Present when the product is visible but not yet purchasable.

sellable_tier.description: Name of the tier that is the reason why this product is sellable for this user, only present if this product is not sellable by default but it is for this user.

shipment_date.description: Date when the product becomes shippable. Present when the product is sellable but not yet shippable (pre-sale).

AssortmentRuleSummary.description: Summary of assortment rule evaluation for the product in the current assortment.

EVA.Core.Products.CreateProductStructure.description: Create a new structure of products.

EVA.Core.Products.DeleteProductStructure.description: Deletes an existing structure of products by `ID`.

EVA.Core.Products.EditProductStructure.description: Edits an existing structure of products by `ID`.

NeverSellable.description: True when the effective SellableDate is the year-9999 sentinel meaning the product is never sellable.

NeverShippable.description: True when the effective ShipmentDate is the year-9999 sentinel meaning the product is never shippable.

NeverVisible.description: True when the effective VisibleDate is the year-9999 sentinel meaning the product is never visible.

SellableNow.description: True when the effective SellableDate is in the past, meaning the product is currently sellable.

NeverSellable.description: True when the tier's effective SellableDate is the year-9999 sentinel meaning the product is never sellable for this tier.

SellableNow.description: True when the tier's effective SellableDate is in the past, meaning the product is currently sellable for this tier.

EVA.Core.Products.GetAssortmentRuleSumma.description: Get the assortment rule summary for a product, evaluated from the current user's perspective.

CustomerID.description: Optional customer ID to evaluate rules from the customer's perspective. Only honoured for employees and API users; ignored for other callers.

Summary.description: Summary of the assortment rule outcomes for this product.

EVA.Core.Products.GetGreetingCards.description: Returns a list of greeting cards. This is limited to 25 cards.

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductAssortmentRu.description: Get the assortment rule details for a product, this is an overview of all rules that can apply to a product.

ProductID.description: The product to get the assortment rule details for.

Summary.description: Summary of the assortment rule outcomes for this product.

HasAssortmentRules.description: Indicates whether there are assortment rules that apply to this product.

StockProducts.description: Stock products that are part of this stock aggregate product. Only returned if the request product is a stock aggregate.

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductPrices.description:
This service is used to list prices associated with the products determined by IDs.

Price - this value has TaxRate applied
PriceInTax - value without TaxRate

A product has more associated prices with different usage types, e.g. Cost, Sales..

Request e.g.:
{
  "ProductIDs": [
    "productId1",
    "productId2"
  ]
}

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductRelations.description: Get product relations by product id

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductRequirementV.description: List all ProductRequirement values for an Order
List all ProductRequirement values for an OrderLine

EVA.Core.Products.GetProducts.description: Fetch one or more products by ID.

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductStructure.description: Retrieve the structure of products by `Code` (and for given `LanguageID`/`CountryID`).

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductUnitOfMeasur.description: Fetch available units of measure for the provided products and their quantities.

EVA.Core.Products.GetProductWarranty.description:
Get product warranty information by making a request to an endpoint set with the 'Product:WarrantyEndpoint' setting.

If 'SerialNumber' is not set in the request, we'll try to get it using the 'OrderLineID', so at least one or the other must be present and valid.

EVA.Core.Products.PrintProductPriceLabel.description: This service is used to print labels containing the price details of one product

ID.description: The ID of the product

Quantity.description: How many copies of the price label should be printed

StationID.description: ID of the printer where the label(s) will be printed

EVA.Core.Products.SearchProducts.description: Performs a search for products, given a `Query` string.

Explain.description: If Explain is set to true the response will contain an explanation of how the search was performed. This is ignored if you do not have the ProductSearchExplanations functionality.

AvailabilityOptions.description: If something is defined in these options, the GetProductAvailability results will be added to the response

CustomerID.description: Customer to use for evaluating assortment rule summary. Does not affect product filtering. Only available for employees.

IncludeConnectedWishlistForProduct.description: Include the customer wishlists that contain this product.

IncludePrefigureDiscounts.description: Include the results of a PrefigureDiscounts call in the result

IncludeProductBundleRelationship.description: Include the information on whether or not a product is part of bundle.

IncludeSerialNumberConfiguration.description: Include the product serial number configuration

IncludeStockProducts.description: If a product is a StockAggregate product, include the underlying SKUs in the result.

OrderID.description: Order to use for additional options

StockAggregateHandling.description: Determines the way we handle stock products.

EVA.Core.Products.UpdateProductRequireme.description: Replace the given ProductRequirement values for an OrderLine with new values

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.ActivateUs.description: Activates a UserProductSubscription that is in PendingActivation status. Only available for subscriptions whose ProductSubscription is configured with Manual activation.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.AddSubscri.description: The normal `AddProductToOrder` cannot be used for adding a Product with type `SubscriptionProduct` to an order. Instead this service must be used.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.CancelProd.description: Cancel a ProductSubscription for a User.
Cancel a previously scheduled product subscription upgrade. The subscription continues with its current product subscription.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.CreateUser.description:
Manually trigger the cancellation order for a UserProductSubscription that is scheduled for cancellation. Only available during testing.
If the provided CancellationEffectiveDate is invalid, it will be capped at the subscription's renewal date or adjusted to ensure the subscription is active for at least one day.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.GetPotenti.description:
This service returns the subscriptions for which you currently have at least one trigger product in the provided order.
This can then be used to suggest subscriptions to the end-user that they're missing out on.

The IncludedFields field controls which product content you get back for each subscription product. By default, only the product's display value is returned.

Specifying the ProductIDs field means that only suggestions for the given products are returned.
If the Order does not contain the provided ProductIDs, nothing will be returned.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.GetProduct.description: Get all ProductSubscriptions for a User.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.GetSubscri.description:
Gets the details of a subscription by its ProductID. The input to this service is `SubscriptionProductID` which refers to the ID
of a `Product` that has `Type` = `SubscriptionProduct`.

The `IncludedFields` parameter is optional and allows you to specify which fields you wish to get back from this service.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.GetTrigger.description:
This service returns a list of subscription products that have the `ProductID` as trigger product.
The service is meant to be used on a product detail page as a "these subscriptions are available for this product" component.
The request allows you to specify what data you'd like to get back from the subscription product, through the `IncludedFields` field.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.GetUserPro.description: Get all the details for a specifc user product subscription.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.PauseProdu.description: Pause a ProductSubscription for a User.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.RenewProdu.description: Renew a Manual ProductSubscription. Only available during testing

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.ResumeProd.description: Resume a ProductSubscription for a User.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.UpdateUser.description: Update the addresses of a UserProductSubscription, these are used for renewals.
Generate an Order to update the payment of a UserProductSubscription

Updates the price on a batch of UserProductSubscriptions. The new price is stored on the subscription and is used from the next renewal.
If an entry's value is null, the price is resolved using the user's pricing group and the order's original sold-from organization unit; subscriptions for which a price cannot be resolved are reported in UserProductSubscriptionsWithPriceError and are not updated.

EVA.Core.ProductSubscriptions.UpgradePro.description: Schedule an upgrade or downgrade to a different product subscription. Takes effect at the next renewal date. Reuses the current payment token. The price is locked at the moment this service is called.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.AddPurchaseOrder.description:
Add lines to an existing purchase order

It is required to supply an OrderID and at least one line with a ProductID and a Quantity. All other line properties are optional.
It's not allowed to create multiple lines with the same product on the same stocklabel.

CurrencyID.description: The currency of the unit price. If not supplied, the order's currency will be used. The UnitPrice will be converted to the order's currency. If no exchangerate is available, the UnitPrice will be ignored and the price is fetched from an available pricelist.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.ConfirmPurchaseO.description:
Confirms that specified Purchase Order will be delivered, identified by the `OrderID` parameter.

Optionally use the `BackendID` parameter to set the BackendID on the Purchase Order.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.CreatePurchaseOr.description:
Creates a Purchase Order for supplied `OrganizationUnitID`, from optional `SupplierID`.

Use the `BackendID` to indicate the supplier order reference.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.CreateShipmentRe.description:
Creates a shipment receipt with `Lines` for specified `ShipmentID`.

* `CompletesShipment` / `Lines.CompletesShipmentLine` will close the shipment (line) for futher receipts
* `Lines.QuantityReceived` is the delta quantity received in this receipt, so not the new total quantity received
* `StockLabelID` is the target StockLabel for the received stock - overrides the StockLabel of the purchase order line

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.FullyReceiveShip.description: Receives a shipment completely as-is. Supply either `ID` or `BackendID`.

StockLabelID.description: The stock label to receive stock on. When provided, received stock will be posted to this label instead of the default.

ShippedFromOrganizationUnitID.description: The OrganizationUnit the shipment was physically shipped from.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.GetProductSuppli.description: Get the supplier product info for a set of product IDs (not supplier product IDs) and the optional supplier OU.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.GetShipmentDetai.description: Get details of a shipment to receive, either by `ID` or by `BackendID`/`OrganizationUnitID` combination.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.ReceivePurchaseO.description:
Receive (part of) a Shipment for a PurchaseOrder.

A ShipmentID is required.

When doing partial receipts it is strongly advised to supply a BackendSystemID and BackendID to make sure Receipts are not created twice.

To do partial receipts the FinalShipment property should be set to false, otherwise the shipment will be close afterwards and the remaining lines will be booked as missing.

When available it is preferred to identify the ShipmentLines with the ShipmentLineID and not with the ProductID.

CompleteShipment.description: If passed in as true this will close the shipment for further receipts.

Receipts.description: The receipts to create. If left null, it's assumed you wish to receive the entire shipment. If left empty, it's assumed you wish to receive nothing.

ReceiveOnStockLabelID.description: The stock label to receive stock on. When provided, received stock will be posted to this label instead of the default.

UndeclaredProductsReceipts.description: Receipts for products that are not present in the shipment. This can only be used for products that are not declard in the shipment.

ProductID.description: The product to receive. This can only be a product that is not in the shipment.

QuantityReceived.description: The quantity to receive. If left null, the quantity not yet received will be used.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.ShipPurchaseOrde.description: Creates a shipment for given purchase order lines and ships it!

ShippedFromOrganizationUnitID.description: The OrganizationUnit the shipment was physically shipped from.

SerialNumbers.description: Serial numbers for the items being shipped.

EVA.Core.PurchaseOrders.SupplierCreateOr.description:
Creates a purchase order (or updates it if it already exists).

When the order already exists, only the lines can be updated (see `SupplierUpdatePurchaseOrder`) - other properties will be ignored.

:lightbulb: Using `SupplierCreateOrder` and `SupplierUpdatePurchaseOrder` is preferred.

BackendID.description: Identifer of the order from the 3rd party

BackendSystemID.description: Identifier of the 3rd party system that created the order

CopyBackendReferenceOnShip.description: Copy the orderlines backendreference to the shipmentlines backendreference, works only if `Ship` is set to true

ExpectedDeliveryDate.description: Date that the supplier expects to deliver the shipment(s) of the purchase order

Receive.description: Receive the order immediately after shipping, works only if `Ship` is set to true

Ship.description: Ship the order immediately after creation. Order won't be shipped again after an update.

ShipFromOrganizationUnitID.description: OrganizationUnit who will be supplying the stock.

ShipmentBackendID.description: BackendID of the shipment to be created. Works only if `Ship` is set to true. Make sure this is unique.

ShipmentIdentifiers.description: Identifiers to set on the shipment if any. Works only if `Ship` is set to true.

ShipToOrganizationUnitID.description: OrganizationUnit that will be receiving the purchase order shipment(s).

BackendReference.description: The BackendReference of the line to create. Note that multiple lines with the same product are merged into a single line so the chosen BackendReference is arbitrary.

CurrencyID.description: The currency of the unit price. If not supplied, the order's currency will be used. The UnitPrice will be converted to the order's currency. If no exchangerate is available, the UnitPrice will be ignored and the price is fetched from an available pricelist.

ExpectedDeliveryDate.description: Date that the supplier expects to deliver this orderline. If you supply multiple lines with the same ProductID, we only take the latest date.

Quantity.description: Quantity that is expected to be shipped

BackendID.description: Identifier of the order from the 3rd party

EVA.Core.Security.MagicLink.SendMagicLin.description:
Requests a magic login link, which will send an email to the user (if found).

- Setting `MagicLink:Enabled` must be enabled explicitly
- When using a `RedirectUrl`, configure setting `MagicLink:RedirectDomains` to whitelist supported redirect hosts (recommended!)

Using the returned `RequestToken`, you can either subscribe to the `/magicLink` SignalR hub, or poll the `CheckMagicLink` service. As soon as the emailed magic link is clicked, that hub and service
will return either a `TemporaryToken` you can call `Login` with for this user, or an `APIKey` that's already valid and ready to proceed with.

- The email sent contains a link that will work for 10 minutes
- When clicked, this will generate either a `TemporaryToken` that can be used to `Login` with for 3 minutes, or an `ApiKey` that can be used for 1 hour
- This data is additionally exposed through `CheckMagicLink` for 1 minute after clicking
- When using a `TemporaryToken` to log in with, the resulting `AuthenticationToken` is valid for 1 week (or `SessionDuration:MagicLink`) and will refresh every time when used

Finally, when specifying `IncludeManualCode`, the email sent will also contain a short code for the user to _manually_ input into your application - call `ConfirmMagicLink` with both the `RequestToken`
and that `ManualCode` to obtain either the `TemporaryToken` or `ApiKey` like above, when valid.

EVA.Core.SerialNumbers.PushSerialNumbers.description:
Push multiple serial numbers into EVA.

- The `ProductID` is required
- You must either specify *both*, or *neither* of `StockLabelID` and `OrganizationUnitID`

:bulb: Our recommended JSON request size limit is 10 MB
:muscle: So when calling this service with just a `SerialNumber` and a `ProductID`, that should be somewhere between 100.000 and 200.000 serials per call
:warning: When a product belongs to a Serial Number Configuration that is configured with a validation regex, serial numbers pushed for that product must match this regex

This service is built for speeeeeeeeeeeed :rocket:, and so has a slightly different idempotency from other services;

- Skips over errors and attempts to persist as many serial numbers as possible
- Gathers any error encountered and returns (up to 1.000 of) them, so you can fix & retry
- Ignores serial numbers that already exist in EVA
- Ignores duplicates within the same call (but it's undefined which serial number is used)
- Ignores duplicates within multiple simultaneous calls (but it's undefined which serial number is used)
- Skips over serial number validation for second chance products

`LanguageID` and `CountryID` filters are compared against the user context requesting this information, and the `UserTaskTypeID`, `UserTaskSubTypeID`
and `Priority` are taken from the User Task itself. The `Priority` from the User Task will be compared against the `From` and `To` ranges defined,
where the `From` priority is an *inclusive* lower bound, while `To` is the *exclusive* upper bound.

The `Description` will be used to describe the priority, but when left empty, will fall back to `Name`.

An example configuration could be as follows;

```
Language | From | To | Description
---------|------|----|------------
      NL |      |    | Standaard
      NL |   10 |    | Spoed
      DE |      | 10 | Unwichtig
         |      |    | Default
```

A User Task with priority 9 for a Dutch employee would be labelled "Standaard", while for a German colleague this would be called "Unwichtig". A
User Task of priority 10 would be called "Spoed" in Dutch, but "Default" in German.

:sunglasses: For added awesomeness, if you define overlapping priority ranges, we'll select the most narrow range for you.

ValidationRegex.description: Regular expression the scanned value must match. Anchor the pattern (^...$) to require a full match; an unanchored pattern matches substrings. When empty, no format validation is applied.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ListPurchaseOrderShip.description: Paged listing of purchase order shipments filtered by the provided PageConfig.

HasDeviations.description: Only return shipments that have deviations. That is: shipments where the delivered quantity and the shipped quantity differ on any line.

ValidationRegex.description: Regular expression the scanned value must match. Anchor the pattern (^...$) to require a full match; an unanchored pattern matches substrings. When empty, no format validation is applied.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ListShipmentLedgerFor.description: Retrieves a paged list of Shipment Ledgers for specified ShipmentID.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ListShipmentLines.description:
List shipmentlines of a shipment, this service replaces the GetShipmentLines and the ListPurchaseOrderShipmentLines services.

The page size `Limit` has a maximum value of `10.000` for this service.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ListShipmentLineSeria.description: Returns serial numbers on a shipment line with pagination and filtering capabilities.

SerialNumber.description: Filter serial numbers containing this text

EVA.Core.Shipments.ListShipmentPackages.description: Lists shipment packages for a specified shipment

EVA.Core.Shipments.ModifyQuantityShipped.description:
Modify the QuantityShipped on one or more ShipmentLines of a Shipment.

When the new QuantityShipped is 0 it will be cancelled.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ProducePackingSlip.description: Generate a packing slip PDF for a shipment, optionally printing or downloading.

EVA.Core.Shipments.ProducePickSlip.description: Generate pick slips for the provided OrderIDs, optionally printing them.

HasDeviations.description: Indicates that this shipment has lines where the delivered quantity and the shipped quantity differ.

EVA.Core.Shipments.RetryShipmentExport.description: Retry exporting a shipment by ID.

EVA.Core.Shipments.SetShipmentSettings.description:
This service is used in combination with the `GetShipmentSettings` to manage OrganizationUnit settings for Shipments.
Optionally an OrganizationUnitID can be provided, but by default the settings are updated for the current OrganizationUnit.

- DefaultReceiveMethod: How shipments should be received if no custom implementation is available

EVA.Core.Shipments.ShipShipment.description:
Ship an existing shipment that has status Pending.

Works only for SalesOrders at this moment.

Force.description: Allow to force shipment. Requires additional rights

ShipmentDate.description: The moment the shipment was shipped, will be set to DateTime.Now when not set

EVA.Core.Shipments.UndoShipment.description: Removes stock from transit for an unreceived shipment

Remark.description: The reason for undoing the shipment

EVA.Core.Shipments.UndoShipmentReceipt.description: Removes stock for a received shipment

Remark.description: The reason for undoing the shipment

EVA.Core.Shipments.UpdateShipment.description:
Update a Shipment. For shipments with status > Pending, only `ReceiveMethod`, `ShipmentDate` and `ExpectedDeliveryDate` can be updated.
Updating a shipment creates the new necessary shipping lines and packages.
Using the RemoveOtherPackagesAndLines property removes the existing ones.

PackageID.description: Optional. When only lines are provided, the PackageID can be used to create a package for all lines.

ReceiveMethodChangedReason.description: Explanation of why the receive method has been changed

RemoveOtherPackagesAndLines.description: Overwrite the existing Lines and Packages, instead of adding to the existing ones

Quantity.description: When not provided, the QuantityOpen of the OrderLine will be used

ValidationRegex.description: Regular expression the scanned value must match. Anchor the pattern (^...$) to require a full match; an unanchored pattern matches substrings. When empty, no format validation is applied.

EVA.Core.Shipments.UpdateShipmentStatus.description:
Updates the shipment status, creating ledger entries on shipment level.

Will be processed as a whole; a single failing line in `Lines` will prevent all other updates in a single call from persisting.

Date.description: Date the event occurred - leave empty for 'now'.

Description.description: Optional, additional description, most commonly for the carrier status update code description for CarrierStatus types

ShipmentID.description: Identifier of the EVA shipment this update is specific for

Type.description: Type of shipment status update; 0 = CarrierStatus

Value.description: Optional, additional information, most commonly for the carrier status update code (B01, D01, ...) for CarrierStatus types

EVA.Core.Shipments.ValidateShipment.description:
Validates if a Shipment can be shipped in the current state.

Returns if it is valid (`IsValid`) and if not, how much still needs to be paid (`OpenAmountForShipment`).

Ranges.description:
The ranges of the shipping costs based on the order amount. Empty if shipping costs are determined using scripting or no ranges are known for the shipping method.
The ranges are non-overlapping, gapless and sorted by the minimum amount (ascending). The first range has a minimum amount of 0. The last range has a maximum amount of null.

EVA.Core.Stock.AdjustStock.description:
Book a set of Adjustments to modify stock.

An Adjustment should have a `ProductID` to identify the product, an `OrganizationUnitID` to identify the stock keeping organization, a `StockLabelID` (see `GetEnumValues` with type `StockLabel`),
a `StockMutationReasonID` (see `GetEnumValues` with type `StockMutationReasons`) and of course a `Quantity` to actually book.

Supply a `BackendSystemID` on the request and `BackendID`'s on the Adjustments to make the request idempotent (optional). When one adjustment in your request fails, all of them will fail. Duplicate
keys will not be processed again and yield a warning (but thus will not block!).

Optionally supports a `Remark` for each Adjustment.

When specifying a `SerialNumber`, please note the `Quantity` of this adjustment then should either be -1 or 1!

Set `Adjustment.Absolute` to `true` to specify an absolute quantity instead of a delta.

BackendSystemID.description: Optional, unique identifier for the system that owns the `Adjustment.BackendID` as key for the mutation

BackendID.description: Optional, unique identifier for the mutation, combined with the root `BackendSystemID`

ProductID.description: Required product identifier (use the `EVA-IDs-Mode` header to switch identifier keys (`Product.ID`, `Product.BackendID`, ...)

EVA.Core.Stock.BulkMoveStock.description:
Moves stock in bulk from one stock label to another within an organization unit.

Use `MoveAllStock` to move all products on the source label, or specify individual `Products` with quantities.

When `MoveAllStock` is `true` and `Products` are also specified, the products list acts as overrides:
a quantity of `0` excludes that product, a positive quantity overrides the amount to move.

Serial number products are automatically moved individually per serial number.
Partial quantities are not supported for serial number products - they are always moved in full.

EVA.Core.Stock.CommitOrderLines.description:
This service allows you to manually commit the stock for the given OrderLineIDs.
The response contains whether or not the commitment was successful, per OrderLine.

Commitment can be unsucessful for two reasons:

- No commitment is necessary. This is because it's an OrderLine that can't be committed, for example one without a stock product, or because the order type doesn't allow commitments.
- Insufficient stock. This service only allows creating a commitment when there's sufficient available stock. Use the MoveCommitments or UncommitOrderLines services to create available stock.

QuantityToCommit.description:
If specified as non-null and less than the open quantity on the OrderLine this will causse the OrderLine to be split into two.
The ID of the new OrderLine will be returned in the response and the object will have a reference to the OriginalOrderLineID, which is the ID that was specified in the request.

EVA.Core.Stock.CreateStockMutations.description: Creates a stock mutation for the given organization unit and product. Note that this service supports creating delta's as well as modifying in absolute quantities based on the `Delta` property.'

EVA.Core.Stock.CreateStockNotification.description: Creates a StockNotification for a product and organization, for specified EmailAddress - will return its ID.

EVA.Core.Stock.CreateStockNotificationFo.description: Creates a StockNotification for a product and organization (or current when null), for the current user - will return its ID.

EVA.Core.Stock.DeleteStockNotification.description: Deletes a StockNotification by ID. When it was created with an EmailAddress, repeat that in this request by means of authentication.

EVA.Core.Stock.DownloadStockExcelFileTem.description: Download a template format for the stock file to upload.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetProductAvailability.description: This service returns information about product availability.

Options.description: Contains options that let you influence the availability calculation.

OrganizationUnitID.description:
By default the availability is calculated from the perspective of your current OrganizationUnit, which determines which warehouse(s) stock is sourced
from, among other things. You can override the default with an OrganizationUnitID of your choosing and calculate availability from that
OrganizationUnit's perspective.

BackendID.description: Required when `ID` is omitted.

Bundles.description: Contains options that allow you to influence how bundle availability is calculated.

Delivery.description:
Contains options that let you influence if and how delivery availability is calculated. If not specified at all then no delivery availability is
calculated and returned.

IncludeRelatedStockReplacingProducts.description: If set to true then the availability of related stock replacing products is returned.

Pickup.description:
Contains options that let you influence if and how pickup availability is calculated. If not specified at all then no pickup availability is
calculated and returned.

ProductAvailabilityDetails.description:
In addition to the normal data, additional detailed information can be returned for the provided OrganizationUnits and Products.

This information includes the entire supplier hierarchy for each OrganizationUnit, telling you where stock originates from, where it's currently committed.

Also includes information about expected future stock and allocation assignments.

Providing this field as an empty object is interpreted as a request to include this information for all organizations and products.

QuantityAvailable.description: If set to true then the QuantityAvailable is returned. By default this information is only accessible to Employee-type users.

InArea.description: Select the organizations that are considered for carry-out based on a rectangular area defined by the top-left and bottom-right co-ordinates.

IncludeCarryOutOrganizationUnits.description:
If specified as true the response will contain the pickup organizations. Which organizations are included depends on the rest of the request:

- If a rectangular area is specified through `InArea` it will contain the organizations within the area.
- If the radius is specified through `InRadius` it will contain the organizations within the radius of the given center co-ordinates.
- If an explicit list of organizations is specified through `OrganizationUnitIDs` then those are returned.

In all cases, whether or not all of them are returned or only those that contain stock is determined by `IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock`. By
default only organizations with stock are returned.

If the request specifies more than one product, the organization will only be returned if *all* products have stock (unless
`IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock` is `true`).

IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock.description:
If specified as true then all relevant shop OrganizationUnits are returned, whether they have available stock or not.

Defaults to false and only has effect if `IncludeCarryOutOrganizationUnits` is set to `true`.

InRadius.description: Select the organizations that are considered for carry-out based on a circular area defined by the center co-ordinate and a radius (specified in km).

OpeningHoursType.description: When the carry-out organizations are returned, this determines what returned opening-hours are returned. See each value of the enum for details.

OrganizationUnitIDs.description: This can be optionally used to provide a list of shops for which you would like to check carry-out availability.

CurrentShop.description: Returns the carry-out availability date for your current shop.

MostStock.description: Returns the shop that has the most stock available for each product.

AvailabilityDate.description: Include the expected date on which the provided products can be home-delivered.

CountryID.description: Limit OrganizationUnits within the area to those with the provided country. Optional.

AvailabilityDate.description: Include the expected date on which the provided products can be picked-up from a shop.

InArea.description: Select the organizations that are considered for pickup based on a rectangular area defined by the top-left and bottom-right co-ordinates.

IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock.description:
If specified as true then all relevant pick-up OrganizationUnits are returned, whether they have available stock or not.

Defaults to false and only has effect if `IncludePickupOrganizationUnits` is set to `true`.

IncludePickupOrganizationUnits.description:
If specified as true the response will contain the pickup organizations. Which organizations are included depends on the rest of the request:

- If a rectangular area is specified through `InArea` it will contain the organizations within the area.
- If the radius is specified through `InRadius` it will contain the organizations within the radius of the given center co-ordinates.
- If an explicit list of organizations is specified through `OrganizationUnitIDs` then those are returned.

In all cases, whether or not all of them are returned or only those that contain stock is determined by `IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock`. By
default only organizations with stock are returned.

If the request specifies more than one product, the organization will only be returned if *all* products have stock (unless
`IncludeOrganizationUnitsWithoutStock` is `true`).

InRadius.description: Select the organizations that are considered for pickup based on a circular area defined by the center co-ordinate and a radius (specified in km).

OpeningHoursType.description: When the pickup organizations are returned, this determines what returned opening-hours are returned. See each value of the enum for details.

OrganizationUnitIDs.description: This can be optionally used to provide a list of shops for which you would like to check pick-up availability.

Type.description:
This field lets you specify whether the pickup availability date you get back (in case you requested it) for each product should be based on your
current OrganizationUnit, or whether it should be the OrganizationUnit that has the earliest availability for the product. Defaults to FastestShop.

CurrentWeek.description: Openinghours for the current week are returned. Similar to NextSevenDays with the difference that the first item will always be Monday.

NextSevenDays.description:
Openinghours for the next seven days are returned. Each result will contain the date and day-of-week. This will take into account any special
upcoming openinghours.

Regular.description: The regular openinghours for each day of the week will be returned without taking into account any special openinghours or holidays.

Center.description: Defaults to the coordinates of the selected OrganizationUnit when not set, but a RadiusInKm is set.

CountryID.description: Limit OrganizationUnits within the radius to those with the provided country. Optional.

CurrentShop.description: Returns the pickup availability date for your current shop.

FastestShop.description: Returns the shop that has the earliest availability date for each product.

IncludeSuppliers.description:
Determines whether or not the detailed information for the requested organization(s) recursively includes the stock details of their suppliers as well.
Defaults to false if both OrganizationUnitIDs and ProductIDs is left empty, otherwise it defaults to true.
Setting this to false limits the response size in case you only care about the stock details of the specific requested organization(s).

OrganizationUnitIDs.description: Which organization(s) to get the details for, defaults to the OrganizationUnitID provided in the request or to your current organization.

AvailabilityCalculationMethod.description:
Determines how bundle availability is calculated. By default the bundle is said to be available when all required lines of the bundle have at least
one option that has stock. The alternative is that the bundle is only considered available when the default product for each line has stock.

If not provided then the value of the `ProductBundleAvailabilityCalculationMethod` EVA setting is used.

IncludeBundleInformation.description:
When the availability of a bundle is calculated it means that all the products that are part of the bundle become part of the output of
GetProductAvailability. If this option is turned on, the service will also return information about the bundle to make sense of those extra products.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetProductRunRates.description:
Calculates the run-rates for the provided products for the provided warehouse OrganizationUnit, based on a date (`Since`).

The run-rates are returned per SoldFromOrganizationUnit.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetQuantityOnHandForProdu.description:
Calculate and return the current `QuantityOnHand` for supplied `ProductID`s on given organization unit.

Returns a dictionary with `ProductID` as key, and the `QuantityOnHand` as value.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockAvailabilityEstim.description:
Calculates the stock availability for the provided OrderLines that are part of the provided Order.

The return value of this service is a list that contains, per OrderLine, whether or not it can be fulfilled (`CanBeFulfilled`) on the `RequestedDate`.

When an OrderLine doesn't already have a RequestedDate, a RequestedDate of tomorrow is used.

Additionally, a list of AlternativeDates is returned per OrderLine with dates on which it is expected that the OrderLine can be fulfilled.

When OrderLineIDs is left empty, this service will return an estimate for all unshipped lines of the order.

Doesn't work for orders with more than 25 lines.
Given a set of products this service returns a detailed estimate for each product when it's expected to be available.

IncludeShopReplenishments.description: If set to true the service will also return purchase OrderLines meant for shops

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockAvailabilityTimel.description:
Returns the expected availability timeline for the provided `ProductIDs`, from the perspective of the provided `OrganizationUnitID` (optional, defaults to the user's current OrganizationUnitID).

The timeline is ordered chronologically and includes all events that are relevant to the availability of the requested products, including events that happen on the suppliers of the requested OrganizationUnit (such as PurchaseOrder receipts).

Additionally, a `FromDate` (inclusive) and `ToDate` (exclusive) can be used to filter the response by date and a `Type` can be provided to only return timeline items of a certain type.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockByStockLabelForPr.description:
Requests the stock per stock label, per product for the given organization unit. If there is no stock at all for a product the product is not
returned in the response.

OnlyLabelsWithFeatures.description: When true, `StockPerLabel` only contains stock labels that have at least one feature enabled for the current organization unit.

AllSellableQuantityAvailable.description: Sum of the quantity available (quantity on hand minus quantity committed to orders) of all stock labels that are configured as sellable for the current organization unit.

AllSellableQuantityCommitted.description: Sum of the quantity committed to orders of all stock labels that are configured as sellable for the current organization unit.

AllSellableQuantityOnHand.description: Sum of the quantity on hand of all stock labels that are configured as sellable for the current organization unit.

QuantityOnHand.description: The quantity on hand at the current organization unit, summed across all stock labels.

SellableQuantityAvailable.description: The quantity on hand of the built-in `Sellable` stock label at the current organization unit. For configurable products this is the sum of the sellable quantity available of all child products. Despite its name, this does not take committed stock into account; use `AllSellableQuantityAvailable` instead.

SellableStockInStoresWithinApplication.description: The quantity on hand of the built-in `Sellable` stock label, summed across all stores within the current application.

SellableStockInWarehouses.description: The quantity on hand of the built-in `Sellable` stock label per warehouse.

StockPerLabel.description: The quantity on hand per stock label at the current organization unit. Labels without stock are omitted.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockLabelSettingsForL.description:
Returns all organizationunits with the configured setting for a single stocklabel.

Every organizationunit that has any setting set for the stocklabel will be returned.
If an organizationunit has no setting for a specific feature, it will inherit the setting from it’s parent, this is indicated by the `IsInherited` property.

IsInherited.description: Whether this value is inherited from a parent organization unit.

IsDefault.description: Indicates that these are the default settings for the stocklabel. These cannot be changed.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockLabelsForFeature.description: Returns all stocklabels with the configured setting for a single organizationunit.

OrganizationUnitID.description: Optional organizationunit to filter by. If not set, the stocklabels for the current organizationunit will be returned.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockLabelsForFeatures.description: Returns all stocklabels with the configured setting for a single organizationunit.

OrganizationUnitID.description: Optional organizationunit to filter by. If not set, the stocklabels for the current organizationunit will be returned.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockNotification.description: Retrieve a StockNotification for a product and organization, for an EmailAddress - will return its ID, or null when it does not exist.

EVA.Core.Stock.GetStockNotificationForCu.description: Retrieve a StockNotification for a product and organization, for the current user - will return its ID, or null when it does not exist.

EVA.Core.Stock.ListCommittedOrderLines.description: This service lists the OrderLines for the given ProductID that currently have committed Stock.

EVA.Core.Stock.ListStock.description: Returns a paginated list of all stock, optionally filtered.

EVA.Core.Stock.ListStockMutations.description: The page size `Limit` has a maximum value of `1.000` for this service.

EVA.Core.Stock.MoveCommitments.description:
This service allows you to move stock commitments from one OrderLine (`SourceOrderLineID`) to another OrderLine (`DestinationOrderLineID`).

- If the Source and Destination do not share the same ProductID, a `CannotMoveCommitment` error is returned.
- If the Source does not have a commitment, a `CannotMoveCommitment` error is returned.

EVA.Core.Stock.MoveStock.description:
Books a set of Movements.

A Movement should have a `ProductID` to identify the product, an `OrganizationUnitID` to identify the stock keeping
organization, a `SourceStockLabelID` and `DestinationStockLabelID` (see `GetEnumValues` with type `StockLabel`) and (of course) a `Quantity`
to actually book.

Supply a `BackendSystemID` on the request and `BackendID`'s on the Movements to make the request idempotent.

Optionally supports a `StockMutationReasonID` and `Remark` for each Movement.

EVA.Core.Stock.ProcessStockMutationFile.description:
Processes a (delta)stock mutation file.

Expected format of the file is JSON with the following markup:

```
[
  {
    "ProductID": [Optional, int],
    "ProductBackendID": [Optional, string],
    "Barcode": [Optional, string],
    "QuantityOnHand": [Required, int, value >= 0],
    "StockMutationReasonID": [Optional, int],
    "Remark": [Optional, string]
  },
  ...
]
```

Products are identified using one of three fields with the following precedence: ProductID > ProductBackendID > Barcode.
Mutation will only be processed for products that can be resolved through one of these identifiers.

EmailAddress.description: An email address to mail the processing result to. When left empty, the logged in user context will be used

IsFullStockMutationFile.description:
If set to false (default), only the stock for the products that are present in the file will be updated (delta).

If set to true, all the products will be updated - products not present in the file will be updated to quantity 0.

HasStock.description: HasStock will be true if the OrganizationUnit has stock for *all* requested products.
HasStock will be true if the OrganizationUnit has stock for *all* requested products.

BundleInformation.description: Contains the lines and option that this bundle consists of (if the product is a bundle product).

HasStock.description: Indicates whether or not there is currently stock available for pick-up.
Indicates whether or not there is currently stock available for home-delivery.

ShipmentDate.description: When the product can ship. Present for pre-sale products where ShipmentDate is in the future.

HasStock.description: Indicates whether or not there is currently stock available for pick-up.

ShipmentDate.description: When the product can ship. Present for pre-sale products where ShipmentDate is in the future.

EffectiveQuantityAvailable.description: See EffectiveQuantityOnHand, but here the commitments are subtracted from the on hand stock. So if physical stock is 100, 80% is allocated to other organizations and there is a commitment of 11 then EffectiveQuantityAvailable will be 9.

EffectiveQuantityOnHand.description:
The quantity of the physical stock that is available to the OrganizationUnit for which this OrganizationUnit is a supplier.

This can differ from the QuantityOnHand when it comes to stock allocation. It's possible that the supplier reserves stock for certain other OrganizationUnits, meaning
that only a portion of the QuantityOnHand is available.

Example: you request stock details for the website, which is supplied by the warehouse organization. There is a stock allocation rule that 80% of the warehouse stock
is reserved to shops, so not available to the website. In that case, the website organization will have a stock detail with warehouse as a supplier and the stock detail
for the warehouse will (for example) have a QuantityOnHand of 100 but only an EffectiveQuantityOnHand of 20.

ExpectedAvailabilityDate.description: The date that this organization is expected to have stock.

ExpectedStock.description: The stock that is expected to be received in the future.

ExpectedSupplierAvailabilityDate.description: The earliest date that one of the suppliers of this organization has stock.

OrdersWaitingForStockQuantity.description: The total quantity of orders that are currently have a fulfillment status of WaitingForStock, meaning that they are waiting until stock becomes available on this OrganizationUnit.

QuantityAvailable.description: The quantity of stock that is still available for the OrganizationUnit, so the amount of physical stock minus its commitments.

QuantityCommitted.description: The quantity that has been committed to this OrganizationUnit.

QuantityOnHand.description: The quantity of stock that the OrganizationUnit physically has.

QuantityReservedForOtherOrganizationUnit.description: The sum of all StockReservations, meaning the quantities that were reserved on this supplier for other organizations.

StockProducts.description: Details of the individual stock products.

StockReservations.description: The stock that is reserved for other organizations that is not available to this organization.

SupplierQuantityCommitted.description: The quantity committed on all suppliers of this organization

SupplierQuantityOnHand.description:
The quantity that all suppliers have on hand as far as we know from the perspective of the organization that is supplied by them.

The actual supplier might have more stock physically on hand, but due to allocation rules this might not be available to this organization.

ExpectedOnStockDate.description: The date on which the stock is expected to be received.

OrderID.description: The OrderID that the expected stock is expected to be received on.

Quantity.description: The quantity that is expected to be received.

QuantityCommitted.description: How much of this expected stock is already spoken for by orders.

ProductID.description: The ID of the stock product.

QuantityAvailable.description: The quantity of stock that is still available for the OrganizationUnit, so the amount of physical stock minus its commitments.

QuantityCommitted.description: The quantity that has been committed to this OrganizationUnit.

QuantityOnHand.description: The quantity of stock that the OrganizationUnit physically has.

SupplierQuantityCommitted.description: The quantity committed on all suppliers of this organization

SupplierQuantityOnHand.description:
The quantity that all suppliers have on hand as far as we know from the perspective of the organization that is supplied by them.

The actual supplier might have more stock physically on hand, but due to allocation rules this might not be available to this organization.

Quantity.description: The quantity that is reserved, so this is the quantity that is not available to our organization

ReservedForOrganizationUnit.description: The organization unit for which the stock is reserved.

EVA.Core.Stock.SetStockLabelSettings.description: Change the settings for a specific OU/StockLabel combination. Use a value of null to make it inherit from it’s parent.

EVA.Core.Stock.UncommitOrderLines.description: This service allows you to undo a commitment on the given OrderLineIDs, making the committed stock available to other orders again.

EVA.Core.Stock.UpdateStock.description:
Updates the Sellable stock of the given products for specified `OrganizationUnitID`, or when omitted, your current organization unit.

Specify the new, absolute quantities as values in the `Products` list. Products that are not mentioned will not be modified.

EVA.Core.Stock.UploadAndProcessStockExce.description: Upload stock Excel (delta)file. The service processes the data async. This service is intended for small files (up to 5MB). Please view the documentation for processing larger files.

EmailAddress.description: An email address to mail the processing result to. When left empty, the logged in user context will be used

IsFullStockMutationFile.description:
If set to false (default), only the stock for the products that are present in the file will be updated (delta).

If set to true, all the products will be updated - products not present in the file will be updated to quantity 0.

EVA.Core.Stock.UploadAndProcessStockJSON.description: Upload stock JSON (delta)file. The service processes the data async.This service is intended for small files (up to 5MB). Please view the documentation for processing larger files.

Data.description:
Should be a JSON formatted array of objects with these properties;

- `ProductID` (optional, int)
- `ProductBackendID` (optional, string)
- `Barcode` (optional, string)
- `QuantityOnHand` (required, int, value >= 0)
- `StockMutationReasonID` (optional, int)
- `Remark` (optional, string)

Products are identified using one of three fields with the following precedence: ProductID > ProductBackendID > Barcode.
Mutation will only be processed for products that can be resolved through one of these identifiers.

EmailAddress.description: An email address to mail the processing result to. When left empty, the logged in user context will be used

IsFullStockMutationFile.description:
If set to false (default), only the stock for the products that are present in the file will be updated (delta).

If set to true, all the products will be updated - products not present in the file will be updated to quantity 0.

EVA.Core.StockMovementFollowUp.CompleteS.description: Completes a Stock Movement Follow Up task, using the `WorkSet` returned by the `StartStockMovementFollowUp` service.

Quantity.description: The quantity moved (optional, use in case of a deviation - defaults to the full original amount)

EVA.Core.StockMovementFollowUp.StartStoc.description: Starts a Stock Movement Follow Up task. Proceed with the `CompleteStockMovementFollowUp` service when finished.

ExpandSetIntoIndividualOrganizationUnits.description: If set to true, this will be expanded into individual OrganizationUnit suppliers. Only works with `SupplierOrganizationUnitID` and `OrganizationUnitSetID`

OrganizationUnitID.description:
This will be the OrganizationUnit that will be supplied to by the supplier.

If neither OrganizationUnitID or OrganizationUnitSetID or OrganizationUnitIDs are specified then all children of the supplier are automatically supplied to.

OrganizationUnitIDs.description:
These will be the OrganizationUnits that will be supplied to by the supplier.

If neither OrganizationUnitID or OrganizationUnitSetID or OrganizationUnitIDs are specified then all children of the supplier are automatically supplied to.

OrganizationUnitSetID.description:
The OrganizationUnitSet that will be supplied to by the supplier. Set memberships are resolved dynamically: when the set's members change, the supplier relationships change with them.

Can be combined with any supplier-side parameter (single OU, OU set, or list of OUs). If neither OrganizationUnitID or OrganizationUnitSetID or OrganizationUnitIDs are specified then all children of the supplier are automatically supplied to (only valid when the supplier is a single OU).

SchedulingConfig.description: Optional schedule that drives the daily refill of this relation's stock allocation rules. Evaluated in UTC. When omitted, the relation's rules are never refilled automatically (manual or config-triggered only). An `OrganizationUnitSupplier` `allocation_refilled` event export is emitted after each scheduled refill completes.

SupplierOrganizationUnitID.description:

DeactivationReasons.description:
You can filter surveys based on their deactivation reason.The array is interpreted as an 'or' value list
To get surveys with a specific deactivation reason, only provide the deactivation reason you want. For example:
- providing an empty value will return all surveys
- providing `None` (0) will return surveys that are active.
- providing `Unpublished` (1) will return surveys that are inactive because they are unpublished.
- providing `Unpublished` (1) and `DeactivatedByUser` (2) will return surveys that are inactive because they are either unpublished OR deactivated by user.
- providing `Unpublished` (1) and `DeactivatedByUser` (2) as a combined flag (3) will return surveys that are inactive because they are unpublished AND deactivated by user.

EVA.DataLake.Backfill.DataLakeBackfill.description:
Manually re-export specific DataLake documents.

These types are currently supported;

* `FinancialPeriods` = 1
* `Orders` = 2
* `Invoices` = 3
* `Users` = 4
* `Discounts` = 5
* `UserBatches` = 6 (can only be used with `From` and `To`)
* `Cases` = 7
* `Shipments` = 8
* `ZonedCycleCounts` = 9
* `UserTasks` = 10
* `StockMutations` = 11
* `UserLoyaltyPointMutations` = 12 (can only be used with the `ID` or `IDs`. These need to be the user ID's of which the loyalty point mutation will be exported.)
* `LoyaltyProgramGroups` = 13 (can only be used with the `ID` or `IDs`.)
* `LoyaltyPrograms` = 14 (can only be used with the `ID` or `IDs`.)
* `FullStockCounts` = 15 (can only be used with the `ID` or `IDs`.)
* `StockNotifications` = 16 (can only be used with the `ID` or `IDs`.)
* `ProductSubscriptions` = 17 (can only be used with `From` and `To`)
* `TransputJobs` = 18
* `DiscountCoupons` = 19 (can only be used with a single `ID`. This needs to be the discount ID whose coupons will be exported.)

Specify either a single `ID`, a list of `IDs`, or a datetime range `From` and `To` (inclusive).

For the following types, you can optionally specify an `OrganizationUnitID` to filter results within a datetime range:
