EVA.Payment.Core.Pin.Services.AcquireCar.description:
Acquire a card on a PIN terminal so EVA can recognize the customer from the card before any payment exists.

The terminal reads the card, the service maps the returned card alias to a known customer (using the same
shopper-recognition mechanism that StartTransaction uses after a payment), and immediately aborts the acquisition so the
terminal is free for the next interaction. No PaymentTransaction is created, no charge happens.

When Pin:AutoAttachCustomerOnCardAcquisition is true and a customer matches, the customer is attached to the order
automatically. Default is false: the caller decides what to do with the resolved user.

Acquire a card on a PIN terminal to find existing orders paid with that card, before any payment exists.

The terminal reads the card, the service derives a stable reference from it (the card alias) and returns a hashed
CardReference. Pass that value to the SearchOrders `PaymentCardReference` filter to list the matching orders — e.g. to
process a return without a receipt. The acquisition is aborted immediately, so no PaymentTransaction is created and no
charge happens.

Both this service and the SearchOrders filter require the SearchOrdersByCardReference functionality: linking a card to
prior (possibly anonymous) orders is a de-anonymization capability, so it is gated and should be granted sparingly.

Acquire a card for an existing PaymentTransaction so the cashier can pick installment counts before charging.

Call this right after CreatePayment when the PaymentType has BIN-keyed installment rules: the terminal reads the card,
EVA persists the acquisition token on the PaymentTransaction, and the response surfaces the installment counts allowed
for the detected card's BIN. The terminal keeps holding the card, so the subsequent StartTransaction charges that same
card without a re-tap.

To cancel without charging, the cashier should call AbortTransaction (which also releases the held card).

EVA.PIM.Services.Products.CreateProduct.description:
Creates a new Product, given at least your `PrimitiveName` and `ProductType`.

- [x]  Given `PrimitiveName` is a name for the product to help you recognise it, but is rarely exposed to users or customers. This property does not support localization or translations!
- [x]  `TaxCodeID` is an integer value indicating one of the configured TaxCodes.
- [x]  The `ProductType` is a flag enumeration value with one or more of the following possible values;

  * `0` None
  * `1` Stock
  * `2` Insurance
  * `4` Marketing
  * `8` Gift Card
  * `16` Service
  * `64` Custom Pricing
  * `128` External
  * `256` Order Costs
  * `512` System Generated
  * `1024` Product Set
  * `2048` Bundle Product
  * `16384` Configurable
  * `32768` Supplier Product
  * `65536` Template
  * `131072` Second Chance
  * `262144` Not Returnable
  * `524288` + `1` Stock Aggregate
  * `1048576` Subscription Product
  * `2097152` Event

Optionally, you can supply some additional information;

- [] `BackendID` is a number to help you identify this product. **Unique per `OrganizationUnitID` and `BackendSystemID`.**
- [] `BackendSystemID` is a string value to idenfity the source this product originated from - can be anything.
- [] `OrganizationUnitID` is the Organization Unit this product is linked to, or `null` when this is a generic EVA product.
- [] `CustomID` is a string value to help you identify this product, without any constraints, but indexed for optimal performance.
- [] `BrandID` to link it to any `Brand` entity.

EVA.PIM.Services.Products.CreateProductC.description: Create a new product capacity plan, which limits the stock of a product based on the capacity of production.

Direction.description:
The direction of the relation. This can either be;
Unidirectional; one-way relation. For example 'parent-child' or 'replaced by'
Bidirectional; two-way relation. For example 'maybe your also intrested in' or 'others also bought'
Group; collective relation which allows for many products as part of a group. For example 'all products that are blue' or 'all products from summer-2022'. This type does not accept a StockRelationType.

DynamicRelationProductID.description:
You can create dynamic bi- or uni directional relations by defining a `DynamicRelationProductID` in combination with a `ProductSearchTemplateID` or `ProductSearchFilters`.
By setting the `UseDynamicRelationProductAsRelatedProduct` to false (default), the `DynamicRelationProductID` will be considered as the primary product and the result from the `ProductSearchTemplateID` or `ProductSearchFilters` will be considered as related products
By setting the `UseDynamicRelationProductAsRelatedProduct` to true , the result from the `ProductSearchTemplateID` or `ProductSearchFilters` will be considered as primary products and the `DynamicRelationProductID` will be considered as the related product

PrimaryName.description: This is the primary name the relation. For example; if primary name is 'Blocks', the secondary name could be something in the lines of 'Blocked by'.

ProductSearchFilters.description: Only available when Direction is set to `Group`.

ProductSearchTemplateID.description: Only available when Direction is set to `Group`.

SecondaryName.description: This is the secondary name the relation. For example; if primary name is 'Blocks', the secondary name could be something in the lines of 'Blocked by'.

StockRelationType.description:
Indicates which stock relation type the relation has. In most cases this will be 'None'. The following options are available:
None; No stock relation
Replacing; When the PrimaryProduct is no longer in stock, the system can automaticly use the RelatedProduct as it's replacement (or vice versa if `Direction` is set to `Bidirectional`).

DestinationStockLabelID.description: The stock label of the second chance product. If unspecified, defaults to `Sellable`.

MoveStock.description: Moves stock from the original product to the second chance product.

EVA.PIM.Services.Products.EditProduct.description:
Modifies given product by its `ID` for a specific `RevisionID`.

The `Edits` is a list of `ProductEdit` objects, that defines some `Content` and the `LanguageID`, `CountryID` and  `LayerID` it applies to. The `Content` is a Json object with key-value pairs that holds
product information. The keys are simple strings, but the value can be a scalar value (like an int or string), an array of scalar values or an array of objects.

A `Revision` is a versioning container in which one or more product modifications are buffered. The changes to the product do not apply directly, but instead are stored in this `Revision` until it is
ready to be published. Also see the `CreateRevision` and `ApplyRevision` services. When omitted, a new 'quick' `Revision` is created and used here.

A `Layer` is a hierarchical solution to building product data. Every layer has its own `Level`, where the bottom layers will be overwritten by higher layers for colliding properties. A `Layer` has a
`Revision`. Also see the `CreateLayer` service. When omitted, a new 'quick' `Layer` is created and used here.

Retrieves a `Product` with detailed information per `Layer`, from the given `ID` and `RevisionID` parameter.

In the response, `Content` is a Json formatted object containing key-value pair data, where the keys are simple strings and the value can be a scalar value (like an int or string), an array of scalar
values or an array of objects.

The `Types` property in the response data holds meta-data information about the property keys used in the `Content` object like property name, group and (of course) data type.

:point_right: Use the `GetProductForQuickEditByID` service when you want to apply all published `Revision`'s and only need the compressed `Layer` version of `Content`.

EVA.PIM.Services.Products.GetProductForQ.description:
Retrieves a `Product` with detailed information, based on all currently applied `Revision`'s and the `Layer` data compressed into a single truth, from the given `ID` parameter.

In the response, `Content` is a Json formatted object containing key-value pair data, where the keys are simple strings and the value can be a scalar value (like an int or string), an array of scalar
values or an array of objects.

The `Types` property in the response data holds meta-data information about the property keys used in the `Content` object like property name, group and (of course) data type.

:point_right: Use the `GetProductForEditByID` service when you want to specify the `Revision` to apply and receive per-layer `Content`.

AllowEmptyMedia.description: When true, and no media is supplied in the request, existing media on the product will be cleared.

CustomPropertyTypes.description: Optional definitions for custom properties referenced in product content. Use this to create or configure properties on-the-fly.

DownloadMediaInBackground.description: When not specified or explicitly false, media is downloaded during the request and may extend execution time. Defaults to true.

LayerName.description:
The layer on which the content will be stored. Defaults to 'ImportProducts-Base'. If you want to store the content on a different layer, you can specify it here. If the content also
specifies a language/country this will be combined with the provided layer name to create a layer name like '<name> <language> <country>', so the provided LayerName is not necessarily the absolute
value that is used for the layer, only if you leave LanguageID/CountryID as null on the content.

MediaBlobCategory.description: A string that identifies the storage category for product media. Optional; when omitted the SystemID is used instead.

Products.description: The list of products to create or update. If a product does not exist it is created; if a product with the same ID and SystemID exists it is updated.

RootLogicalLevel.description:
The LogicalLevel that will be assigned to root products in the hierarchy. If not specified, a default value is used.

See ProductVariation.LogicalLevel for more information.

SystemID.description:
A string that identifies the upstream system calling this service. Together with a product's ID, this uniquely identifies the product in EVA.
The SystemID must remain consistent across calls; changing it will cause new products to be created instead of updated.

Type.description: Controls how the import is executed (normal, content-only, or preview-only).

WaitForProductComposition.description:
By default the service only blocks long enough to store the requested modifications; additional processing continues asynchronously.
When set to true, the service blocks until the full product composition process is complete.

ID.description: The unique identifier for the media item. Optional; when null an ID is generated from the MediaUrl hash.

IsPrimaryImage.description: When true, marks this media item as the primary image for the product. If multiple items are marked, the last one wins. Ignored for non-image/video media types.

LocationType.description: Storage location type override. Usually left empty to use defaults.

MediaData.description: Raw media bytes. Required only if MediaUrl is not provided.

MediaUrl.description: Where the media can be downloaded from. Required unless MediaData is provided.

MimeType.description: The media MIME type. Optional; when null it will be inferred from the MediaUrl.

Name.description: Human-readable display name for the media item. Optional; defaults to the media ID.

Sequence.description:
Sequence number used for ordering media and determining the primary image.
Smaller numbers mean higher priority. If null, ordering follows the Media array.
Only relative order matters: sequences 1, 2, 4, 7 will be stored as 0, 1, 2, 3.

ContentOnly.description: Only imports content, does not create or update the products themselves. It's required that the products already exist.

Normal.description: A normal import; creates and updates the product structure and stores content, if present.

PreviewOnly.description: A dry-run, does not make any modifications, only returns a representation of the product structure that would be generated in the response.

CommodityCode.description: The CommodityCode is used for customs declarations and product tariffs. Can be used to store the HS code of the product.

GiftCardConfigurationID.description: In case a type GiftCard product is uploaded, its `GiftCardType` or `GiftCardConfigurationID` is mandatory to connect to its provider.

GiftCardData.description: In case a type GiftCard product is uploaded, this defines the optional data for configuration.

GiftCardIsDigital.description: In case a type GiftCard product is uploaded, this defines if the product is digital, so it will not require a serialnumber during checkout.

GiftCardType.description: In case a type GiftCard product is uploaded, its `GiftCardType` or `GiftCardConfigurationID` is mandatory to connect to its provider.

IsFullHierarchy.description:
Controls hierarchy mutation behavior during import.

When true (default): Performs a full hierarchy sync. Products that are children of this product in the database but not included in this import request will be detached (their parent relationship is removed).

When false: Preserves existing parent-child relationships. Only explicitly included products have their hierarchy updated. Use this when doing partial updates to avoid accidentally breaking existing hierarchies.

Example: If you have a shirt with 3 color variations and you re-import just one color to update its price, set IsFullHierarchy=false to prevent the other 2 colors from being detached.

MediaWillBeInheritedByChildren.description:
Determines whether or not any media set on a parent product will inherit down to its children. This defaults to true.
Can be useful to give the root product of a hierarchy an ensemble of the available colors, without inheriting the media items to the children.

ProductRequirements.description: Optional field to set up the product requirements on a product.

RequireSerialNumberForSale.description:
Optional field to indicate a serialnumber will be required when selling this product.

- Will set the serial number configuration of the product to the default configuration, but only if not already set
- Use `SerialNumberConfigurationID` for more control
- Omitting both this field and `SerialNumberConfigurationID` will remove any serial number configuration from the product

SerialNumberConfigurationID.description:
Optional field to indicate what kind of serial number requirements apply to this product.

- Will overwrite the serial number configuration of the product with this specified value, taking precedence over `RequireSerialNumberForSale`
- Omitting both this field AND `RequireSerialNumberForSale` will remove any serial number configuration from the product

TaxCode.description:
The TaxCode determines how sales tax applies to this product. This must refer to an existing TaxCode in EVA, if it doesn't exist yet an error is returned.

Required unless Type = ContentOnly.

The string expected here is the Name property of the tax code, so 'High' for TaxCode High.

EVA defines the following default tax codes:

- High
- Intermediate
- Low
- Zero
- Exempt

In a hierarchy, the TaxCode only has to be specified for the root level; all products part of the hierarchy will always have the same TaxCode.

Variations.description: Defines the variations hierarchy of the product.

VariationValues.description:
Defines the per-language value of the variation property for this product. For example, if the variation property is `color` then the value could be 'red' or 'blue'.

If the variation value isn't language sensitive then the LanguageID should be left null. If there isn't an item where LanguageID is null, all languages for which this product has content must have
a value for the variation property.

AnnouncementDate.description: Optional date when the product is announced for this assortment.

AssortmentCode.description: The backend code of the assortment this product should belong to.

EndDate.description: Optional date when the product stops being active in this assortment.

PreSaleDate.description: Optional date when the product becomes available for pre-sale.

ProductStatus.description: Status flags to apply for this product within the assortment.

ShipmentDate.description: Optional date when the product is expected to ship.

StartDate.description: Optional date when the product becomes active in this assortment.

Assortments.description: If specified this will add the product to those assortments.

Barcodes.description: An (optional) list of barcodes for this product. A barcode should be globally unique and any duplicate barcodes will result in an error.

Brand.description: The (optional) brand of the product. Only has to be specified on the root level of a hierarchy.

Content.description:
The per-language content of the product.

A small set of default properties has been defined, such as Name and MarketingDescription. Additional content can be defined inside `CustomContent`, which is a key-value container
where the key is the name of a property and value should be a single scalar value (string, number, boolean or null) or an array of values.

If LanguageID is left null, this will be the fallback content for languages that have no content of their own.
For example, you may offer a French website but you only have English product content, if you specify your English content with LanguageID = null
then products on the French website will have the English content.

In general, it's a good idea to choose a language that will serve as the default fallback language and to not specify LanguageID for that language's content so it will function as the fallback content.

CountryOfOriginID.description: The country of origin for the product. Value must conform to the 2-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1.

CustomID.description: The custom identifier for the product.

ID.description: The unique identifier for the product.

IsDeleted.description: Set to `True` to delete the product.

LedgerClassID.description: The (optional) ledger class ID of the product. Only has to be specified on the root level of a hierarchy.

ManufacturerID.description: Optional field that can be used to store the manufacturer's identifier for this product.

Name.description: The culture independent name of the product by which it can be recognized even if it otherwise does not have any content. Required unless Type = ContentOnly.

Status.description: Defines the status of a product.

Type.description: Defines what kind of product it is. If the product is part of a hierarchy, this is only relevant for the SKU level, all other levels will have type Configurable.

UnitBarcodes.description: An (optional) list of barcodes with the associated quantity and unit of measure for this product. A barcode should be globally unique and any duplicate barcodes will result in an error.

CountryID.description: Optional country for this content block. Leave null for country-agnostic content.

CustomContent.description: Custom content values keyed by property ID, used for arbitrary content data.

LanguageID.description: Optional language for this content block. Leave null for language-agnostic content.

LongDescription.description: Long-form description, typically used on the product detail page.

MarketingDescription.description: Marketing-focused description used in merchandising contexts.

Media.description: List of product media items (images, videos, etc.).

Name.description: Display name of the product for this language/country.

PublicationStatuses.description: Publication statuses that determine visibility. A product is generally not visible to non-employee users unless it includes a 'public' status.

ShortDescription.description: Short description, typically used in listings or quick views.

Tags.description: Tags used for filtering or merchandising.

UniqueSellingPointBlobIDs.description: Blob IDs for unique selling point assets (images, icons, etc.).

UniqueSellingPointTexts.description: Unique selling point text entries for this content block.

XDimension.description: Optional X-dimension metadata for the product (e.g., width).

YDimension.description: Optional Y-dimension metadata for the product (e.g., height).

PropertyName.description: The name of the dimension property (e.g., 'Width', 'Height').

Value.description: The dimension value, expressed as a string to preserve formatting or units.

ID.description: The unique identifier for the image. Optional; when null an ID is generated from the ImageUrl hash.

ImageData.description: Raw image bytes. Required only if ImageUrl is not provided.

ImageUrl.description: Where the image can be downloaded from. Required unless ImageData is provided.

IsPrimaryImage.description: When true, marks this image as the primary image for the product. If multiple images are marked, the last one wins.

LocationType.description: Storage location type override. Usually left empty to use defaults.

MimeType.description: The image MIME type. Optional; when null it will be inferred from the ImageUrl.

Name.description: Human-readable display name for the image. Optional; defaults to the image ID.

Sequence.description:
Sequence number used for ordering images and determining the primary image.
Smaller numbers mean higher priority. If null, ordering follows the Images array.
Only relative order matters: sequences 1, 2, 4, 7 will be stored as 0, 1, 2, 3.

CategoryID.description: The ID of the category the property belongs to. Defaults to `default`.

CopyToParentProductPropertyTypeID.description:
If provided, the values of this property will be copied to the provided property on the parent products.
This can be useful if you have a `clothing_color` property on the `color` logical level and would like to have an `available_colors` property on the root level that contains all the colors that are available for the product.
In that example the value of the CopyToParentProductPropertyTypeID on the `clothing_color` property would be `available_colors` and the value of the CopyToParentProductPropertyTypeID on the `available_colors` property would be null.
If there is no property yet with this name, it will be automatically created with the same data type as the source property.

If there already exists a property with this name, the data type must match the data type of the source property and the IsArray property must be true as the parent products will be given multiple values from their children.

DataType.description: Defines the data type of the property value.

IndexType.description: Defines whether and how the property is indexed for search. This is a flags enum, so you can combine IndexedNotAnalyzed and IndexedAnalyzed to index both exact and analyzed variants.

IsArray.description: Determines whether the property accepts multiple values (array) or a single value.

ProductPropertyTypeID.description: The ID of the custom property, typically in snake_case.

IndexedAnalyzed.description: The property is indexed and analyzed, meaning the value is broken down to its individual tokens according to the index analyzer.

IndexedNotAnalyzed.description: The property is indexed but not analyzed, which means it will only result in a hit if it's an exact match.

NotIndexed.description: The property is not indexed, meaning it's not searchable.

BackendID.description: Optional backend identifier for external systems.

DataType.description: The data type expected for this requirement.

EnumValues.description: Optional enumeration values keyed by value with display text as the value.

Handler.description: Optional handler name that processes the requirement value.

IsArray.description: When true, the requirement accepts multiple values.

IsRequired.description: When true, the requirement must be provided to complete the order.

Name.description: The display name of the requirement presented to the customer.

OrderType.description: Optional order type this requirement applies to.

CarryOutOnly.description: Product is only available for carry-out.

DeliveryOnly.description: Product is only available for delivery, not store pickup.

DisableBackorder.description: Product cannot be backordered when out of stock.

DisablePickup.description: Product cannot be picked up from a shop.

NonSellable.description: Indicates the product is not sellable.

PreRelease.description: Product is unavailable until the pre-order date.

UseUp.description: Indicates the product is end-of-life; remaining stock is final.

AllowCustomPricing.description: Indicates whether custom pricing is allowed.

BundleProduct.description: Indicates the product is a bundle.

Event.description: An event product intended for scheduling appointments.

Insurance.description: Indicates the product is an insurance product.

NotReturnable.description: A product that cannot be returned.

Service.description: A non-physical product that represents a service.

Stock.description: A normal stock-keeping product. This is the default when no type is specified.

SubscriptionProduct.description: Indicates the product is a subscription.

VirtualProduct.description: Indicates the product is virtual and has no physical form.

LogicalLevel.description:
The LogicalLevel of a product defines the 'level' on which the product can be thought to sit in the hierarchy.

For example, the various different colors of a shirt can be thought to have LogicalLevel = 'color' and the actual SKU might have LogicalLevel = 'size' or 'sku'.

You are free to use any value, but keep it consistent within a product family. This helps frontends group levels (e.g., filter on color and then show sizes on the detail page).

Products.description: The collection of products that represent the variations at the specified LogicalLevel.

Property.description: The property on which the product hierarchy varies, e.g. 'size' or 'color'.

CountryID.description: Optional. Leave null if the variation value is not country-specific.

LanguageID.description: Optional. Leave null if the variation value is not language-specific.

Value.description: The actual value for the variation (e.g., 'XL', 'BLUE').

Barcode.description: The barcode value. Must be unique.

Quantity.description: The quantity of product (in the specified unit of measure) represented by this barcode.

UnitOfMeasureName.description: The unit of measure name for this barcode. If not specified, 'Each' is used. Must exist beforehand.

CreatedProductIDs.description: The EVA IDs of products that were newly created by this call.

PreviewResult.description: If the request Type was PreviewOnly, this contains the generated product structure preview.

ProductMap.description: Mapping entries from each input product ID to its internal EVA integer ID.

UpdatedProductIDs.description: The EVA IDs of products that were updated by this call.

EVA.PIM.Services.Synonyms.ReplaceProduct.description:
Replaces all search synonyms for a given LanguageID/CountryID with the provided ones.
Any synonyms not present in the request but that currently exist will be deleted.

## Rules
The `Rule` must be formatted according to [what Elasticsearch accepts](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/analysis-synonym-tokenfilter.html#_solr_synonyms):

- Comma-separated values: `jump, leap, hop` causes any of the matched terms to be replaced by all of the terms.
- Arrow notation: `britain=>england` causes the left side to be replaced by the right side.

To create a synonym, a `LanguageID` is required.

EVA.Replenishment.Services.CreateRepleni.description:
Creates a new `ReplenishmentProposal`.

The new proposal is picked up and processed asynchronously and could take a while after creation to complete generating its results, depending on the
amount of sources, targets, products and the algorithm used. Check the `Status` property in the `GetReplenishmentProposal` response to see if it's
completed.

To allow selecting the output types for the generated proposal, the property `OutputTypes` can be set. It is a flags enum of the type
`ReplenishmentOutputTypes`. If the `OutputTypes` is not set, it will fall back to the setting `Replenishment:Outputs`.

OutputTypes.description: Optional parameter to override the standard output types for created replenishment proposals

StockLabels.description: Optional list of stock labels to generate replenishment proposal for

SequenceID.description: Ordering of the labels, to determine priority in scarcity

EVA.Replenishment.Services.DownloadReple.description:
Downloads an Excel for `UploadReplenishmentProductsExcel` service, filled with all currently existing records.

Specify either OrganizationUnitIDs or OrganizationUnitSetID. OrganizationUnitSetID takes precedence over OrganizationUnitIDs.

You can't download information for more than 1.000.000 product/organizationunit combinations.

AddPlaceHolderRows.description: Will add empty rows for product/organizationunit combinations that do not exist yet.

Filters.description: Only show products that match this filter.

EVA.Replenishment.Services.GetReplenishm.description:
Get a `ReplenishmentProposal`.

* To get the possible sources of this proposal, use the 'GetReplenishmentProposalSources`.
* To get the targets of this proposal, use the 'GetReplenishmentProposalTargets`.
* To get the stock labels of this proposal, use the 'GetReplenishmentProposalStockLabels`.
* To get the results of this proposal, use the 'GetReplenishmentProposalResults`.
Get all Sources for a `ReplenishmentProposal`, identified by its `ID`. Supports filter option for `OrganizationUnitIDs`.
Get all Stock Labels for a `ReplenishmentProposal`, identified by its `ID`.
Get all Targets for a `ReplenishmentProposal`, identified by its `ID`. Supports filter option for `OrganizationUnitIDs`.

EVA.Replenishment.Services.ImportRepleni.description:
Imports a simple set of ReplenishmentProducts, creating new records and updating existing records.

Does not support `StartDate` and `EndDate`, and as such will error when existing records have these set.

EVA.Replenishment.Services.ListReplenish.description: List the ReplenishmentProducts, optionally with a `PageConfig` with a `Filter`.

AdditionalProperties.description: Additional properties that are returned with each product. It is guaranteed these are present for all products, but it might be an empty string.

EVA.Replenishment.Services.ListReplenish.description:
Lists all Results for a `ReplenishmentProposal`, identified by its `ID`.

Through the `PageConfig`'s `Filter` parameter, you have the following filter options available:

* `SourceIDs` and/or `TargetIDs` as `OrganizationUnit`.`ID`'s
* `ProductIDs` as `Product`.`ID`s
* `CustomID` as `Product`.`CustomID`
* `BrandName` as `Product`.`Brand`.`Name`

List all `ReplenishmentProposal`'s.

Through the `PageConfig`'s `Filter` parameter, you have the following filter options available:

* `ID` for that specific `ReplenishmentProposal` you want
* `SourceIDs` and/or `TargetIDs` as `OrganizationUnit`.`ID`'s
* `CreatedAfter` and/or `CreatedBefore`
* `CreatedByName` (:underage: expensive filter, supports both `FirstName` and `LastName` filtering)

OutputTypes.description: Optional parameter to override the standard output types for created replenishment proposals

EVA.Replenishment.Services.UploadRepleni.description:
Uploads an Excel retrieved from `DownloadReplenishmentProductsExcel`.

Records with `ID` will be modified, records without `ID` will be added. Omitted records will not be modified.

If you add a record that already exists, but is not in the excel due to some filtering (ou or products), it will also be updated.

EVA.Symphony.Services.GetNodeCompletionO.description:
Retrieves the completion options for the provided node that is part of the provided AST.

If no AST is provided this service will return the completion options that a new sheet would have.

The completion options consist of three possible values:

- Alternatives: with which nodes can the requested node be replaced?
- NextStatements: if the node is a statement, which statements can come after it?
- SelfCompletion: if a node contains child nodes, what are the possible node types for those children?

EVA.Symphony.Services.GetSheetDocumentat.description: Returns the available documentation at the provided position (column/line number) in the sheet.

Column.description: The 1-based column number of the position in the sheet that you would like documentation for.

Line.description: The 1-based line number of the position in the sheet that you would like documentation for.

Sheet.description: The sheet that you would like to have documentation for

EVA.Symphony.Services.ListSheets.description: Returns a list of sheets, optionally filtered.

EVA.Symphony.Services.ParseSheet.description: Attempts to parse the provided sheet, returning whether or not it was successful, any errors and possibly autocomplete suggestions.

EVA.Symphony.Services.PreviewOrderFulfil.description:
Provides the ability to do a what-if to see how the provided OrderID would be fulfilled.

This will use the existing sheets with the ability to specify additional new sheets (by not specifying an ID)
or modify an existing sheet (by providing the ID of an existing sheet).

Sheets.description:
If you specify sheets they will either be used as an additional sheet to consider when calculating order fulfillment, or as a replacement for an existing sheet based on whether the ID of the sheet is provided or not.

Specifying additional sheets can be used as a 'what-if' tool; what would happen to this order if I change this sheet to do this, etc.

UseCurrentFulfillments.description:
If specified as true the fulfillment preview will base its result on fulfillments that have already been created for the order. For example if the order has already been exported to a certain supplier
then the preview service will take that into account and not consider that supplier to be a fulfillment option anymore. If specified as false (the default) the service considers the order to be a clean slate
for which all options are still open.

EVA.Symphony.Services.UpdateSheet.description: Updates an existing sheet. Will return an error if the provided sheet cannot be parsed sucessfully.
